title: Encounter Delivery Record
description: One annotated segment of a clinical encounter: the clip, the clinician's read at the time, the move made, and (deferred) outcome linkage. Formalizes action-plan section 4. schema_version 0.1.0.

session_id.description: UUID of the recorded session; for capture=memory, a stable id for the remembered encounter (mem-001 etc.).

capture.description: memory = schema-validation record written from recall (action plan 9.4), no media exists.

clip.description: Session-clock boundaries in seconds. Required when capture=recording.

context.description: Free text, de-identified. Minimal setting needed to understand the read (e.g. 'young adult, first-time parent, febrile infant, 2am'). NO names, dates, locations, or other identifiers.

read.description: Clinician state at t_start — what you were seeing and the register you chose because of it.

affect_observed.description: Open vocabulary; keep suggestion lists polarity-balanced (negative-only anchors skew the corpus). Suggested values: angry, frightened, dismissive, flat, tearful, embarrassed, skeptical, overwhelmed, calm, relieved, cheerful, engaged, trusting, curious, hopeful, stoic.

register_selected.description: Open vocabulary; suggested values: brisk, slow, warm, firm, playful, grave, matter-of-fact.

why.description: What in the presentation drove the register choice. This is the payload.

description.description: What you did and what you were going for.

discriminating_feature.description: The thing that made this call rather than another.

in_frame_response.description: Observable shift in the patient, if any.

outcome.description: Deferred pass; joined later by session_id. Absent at annotation time.

worked.description: 0 = the move failed. Failures are required corpus content (plan 4, non-negotiable).

schema_gap.description: What mattered in this encounter that the fields above could NOT capture. For capture=memory records this field is the point of the exercise (plan 9.4); keep it for recordings too.
